# Mpx 开发指南

本 Skill 提供了 Mpx 框架的基础开发指南索引。Mpx 是一款致力于提高小程序开发体验和开发效率的增强型小程序框架。

## 1. Mpx 框架简介
Mpx 是对小程序原生开发标准的补强和扩充，支持单文件开发、数据响应、增强模板语法等。
- **详细介绍**: [intro.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/intro.md)

## 2. 快速开始
- **项目创建与运行**: [start.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/start.md)
- **项目结构**: [project-structure.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/project-structure.md)
- **IDE 配置**: [ide.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/ide.md)

## 3. 核心概念
Mpx 的核心由 App、Page 和 Component 组成。
- **App (应用实例)**: [app.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/app.md) - 介绍 App 的生命周期、全局配置等。
- **Page (页面)**: [page.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/page.md) - 介绍页面的创建、生命周期、配置等。
- **Component (组件)**: [component.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/component.md) - 介绍自定义组件的创建、属性、生命周期、插槽等。

## 4. 基础语法
Mpx 支持类似 Vue 的开发体验。
- **单文件组件 (SFC)**: [single-file.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/single-file.md)
- **模板语法**: [template.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/template.md)
- **数据绑定**: [data-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/data-binding.md)
- **列表渲染 (wx:for)**: [list-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/list-render.md)
- **条件渲染 (wx:if)**: [conditional-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/conditional-render.md)
- **事件处理**: [event.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/event.md)
- **样式处理 (CSS)**: [css.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/css.md)
- **Class 与 Style 绑定**: [class-style-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/class-style-binding.md)

## 5. 响应式系统
Mpx 提供了强大的数据响应能力。
- **响应式原理**: [reactive.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/reactive.md) - 包含 watch, computed 等。
- **双向绑定**: [two-way-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/two-way-binding.md) - wx:model 语法。
- **引用 (Refs)**: [refs.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/refs.md)

## 6. 其他
- **生命周期**: [lifecycle.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/lifecycle.md)

使用此 Skill 时，请根据用户的问题查阅上述对应的文档文件，并提供准确的代码示例和解释。

        <view class="state-dot"></view>
        <text>{{logisticsOnline ? '实时物流已连接' : '实时物流连接中'}}</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="status-tabs">
      <view
        class="status-tab"
        wx:for="{{statusTabs}}"
        wx:key="key"
        wx:class="{{ {active: item.key === activeStatus} }}"
        bindtap="switchStatus(item.key)"
      >
        <text>{{item.label}}</text>
        <text wx:if="{{item.count}}" class="status-count">{{item.count}}</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="order-list">
      <swipe-order-item
        wx:for="{{orders}}"
        wx:key="id"
        order="{{item}}"
        disabled="{{item.locked}}"
        bindselect="openOrder"
        bindremove="removeOrder"
        bindswipeend="handleSwipeEnd"
      />
    </view>

    </view>

    </view>

      wx:if="{{memberId}}"
      memberId="{{memberId}}"
      bindconnectedchange="handleConnectionChange"
      bindlogistics="handleLogisticsMessage"
      binderror="handleChannelError"
    />
  </view>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    memberId: 'member-10086',
    activeStatus: 'all',
    statusTabs: [
      { key: 'all', label: '全部', count: 0 },
      { key: 'paying', label: '待付款', count: 1 },
      { key: 'shipping', label: '待收货', count: 2 },
      { key: 'done', label: '已完成', count: 0 }
    ],
    orders: [
      {
        id: 'order-20260812001',
        orderNo: '20260812001',
        status: 'shipping',
        statusText: '运输中',
        logisticsText: '包裹已到达上海转运中心',
        updatedAt: '今天 10:26',
        cover: '/assets/orders/blueberry.png',
        title: '云南高山蓝莓 4 盒装',
        skuText: '125g × 4 盒',
        amount: '39.90',
        count: 1,
        locked: false
      },
      {
        id: 'order-20260811008',
        orderNo: '20260811008',
        status: 'shipping',
        statusText: '已揽收',
        logisticsText: '快递员已揽收',
        updatedAt: '昨天 18:42',
        cover: '/assets/orders/coffee.png',
        title: '便携式手冲咖啡套装',
        skuText: '黑色 · 标准版',
        amount: '129.00',
        count: 1,
        locked: false
      }
    ],
    logisticsOnline: false,
    loading: false
  },
  methods: {
    switchStatus (status) {
      if (status === this.activeStatus) return
      this.activeStatus = status
      this.fetchOrders()
    },
    fetchOrders () {
      this.loading = true
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/orders',
        data: { status: this.activeStatus },
        success: ({ data }) => {
          this.orders = data.list
          this.statusTabs = data.summary
        },
        complete: () => {
          this.loading = false
        }
      })
    },
    openOrder ({ detail }) {
      wx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/orders/detail?id=${detail.orderId}` })
    },
    removeOrder ({ detail }) {
      wx.showModal({
        title: '删除订单',
        content: '删除后将无法在订单列表中查看，确认删除吗？',
        success: ({ confirm }) => {
          if (!confirm) return
          wx.request({
            url: `/api/orders/${detail.orderId}`,
            method: 'DELETE',
            success: () => {
              this.orders = this.orders.filter(order => order.id !== detail.orderId)
            }
          })
        }
      })
    },
    handleSwipeEnd ({ detail }) {
      if (!detail.open) return
      this.orders = this.orders.map(order => {
        return Object.assign({}, order, { locked: order.id !== detail.orderId })
      })
    },
    handleConnectionChange ({ detail }) {
      this.logisticsOnline = detail.connected
    },
    handleLogisticsMessage ({ detail }) {
      this.orders = this.orders.map(order => {
        if (order.id !== detail.orderId) return order
        return Object.assign({}, order, {
          status: detail.status,
          statusText: detail.statusText,
          logisticsText: detail.logisticsText,
          updatedAt: detail.updatedAt
        })
      })
    },
    handleChannelError () {
      this.logisticsOnline = false
    },
    goShopping () {
      wx.switchTab({ url: '/pages/home/index' })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script module="gesture" lang="wxs">
var startX = 0
var currentOffset = 0

function pointX(event) {
  var touches = event.touches && event.touches.length ? event.touches : event.changedTouches
  return touches && touches.length ? touches[0].clientX : 0
}

module.exports = {
  onTouchStart: function (event) {
    if (event.currentTarget.dataset.disabled) return
    startX = pointX(event)
    currentOffset = 0
    event.instance.callMethod('beginSwipe')
  },
  onTouchMove: function (event) {
    if (event.currentTarget.dataset.disabled) return
    currentOffset = pointX(event) - startX
    if (currentOffset > 0) currentOffset = 0
    if (currentOffset < -96) currentOffset = -96
    event.instance.callMethod('syncSwipeOffset', currentOffset)
  },
  onTouchEnd: function (event) {
    if (event.currentTarget.dataset.disabled) return
    event.instance.callMethod('finishSwipe', currentOffset <= -48)
  },
  onTouchCancel: function (event) {
    if (event.currentTarget.dataset.disabled) return
    currentOffset = 0
    event.instance.callMethod('cancelSwipe')
  }
}
</script>

import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    memberId: {
      type: String,
      observer () {
        this.connectChannel()
      }
    }
  },
  data: {
    connected: false
  },
  attached () {
    this.connectChannel()
  },
  detached () {
    wx.closeSocket()
  },
  methods: {
    connectChannel () {
      if (!this.memberId) return
      wx.connectSocket({
        url: `wss://logistics.example.com/members/${this.memberId}`,
        header: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${wx.getStorageSync('token')}`
        }
      })
      wx.onSocketOpen(() => {
        this.connected = true
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: true })
      })
      wx.onSocketMessage(({ data }) => {
        const message = JSON.parse(data)
        if (message.type === 'logistics') {
          this.triggerEvent('logistics', message.payload)
        }
      })
      wx.onSocketError((error) => {
        this.connected = false
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: false })
        this.triggerEvent('error', { error })
      })
      wx.onSocketClose(() => {
        this.connected = false
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: false })
      })
    },
    reconnect () {
      wx.closeSocket()
      this.connectChannel()
    },
    sendHeartbeat () {
      wx.sendSocketMessage({
        data: JSON.stringify({ type: 'ping', memberId: this.memberId })
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>

实现内容：

- 左滑严格限制为 96px，超过 48px 才展开，否则回弹。
- Web 使用组件事件；微信小程序保留 WXS 高频位移路径。
- 独立手势状态、滑动后点击抑制、禁用项完整拦截。
- 使用实例级 `SocketTask`，通过连接代次、会员 ID 和生命周期校验隔离旧事件。
- 会员切换、重连、离页时关闭并清理旧连接。
- 保留筛选、详情、删除及实时物流更新，并增加筛选请求竞态保护。
- 三个文件均通过 JavaScript、WXS 和 JSON 配置静态解析检查。
